title: i'v built an autonomous OSINT terminal on Replit that outruns mainstream media. Here is the live track record page to audit my AI agents.
author: Alternative_Job9720
selftext:
I’ve been working as a solo dev on a project called **All-Trace**. The goal is simple: bypass the noise of legacy media by letting an autonomous ecosystem of AI agents map global frictions (on-chain movements, maritime choke points, and localized OSINT networks) in real-time.

Instead of writing another "AI wrapper," I focused entirely on **predictive velocity**. My core agent, Atlas, cross-references raw data feeds to capture market-moving signals hours before they hit the press.

**Why I’m posting this here:** I built, deployed, and scaled the entire backend on **Replit**. As a solopreneur, Replit has been my unfair advantage. It handles the continuous loops of my agentic workflows, the webhooks, and the automated PDF generation without forcing me into a DevOps nightmare. It’s the only infrastructure that lets a single developer compete with newsrooms backed by multi-million dollar budgets.

**The Proof:** Reddit hates vague promises, so I built a dedicated page where every single prediction made by my agents is time-stamped and logged publicly. If the AI is wrong, it’s there. If it’s right (like pinning down the exact June macroeconomic shifts and crypto liquidity support levels weeks ago), it’s there.

I want you guys to break it, audit it, and tell me what you think of the architecture.
